lines.text: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim.
The king of Arad attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.
Israel built an altar to the LORD and asked Him to deliver the people into their hands.
Israel vowed to devote their cities to destruction, and the LORD heard their plea and delivered up the Canaanites.
Israel devoted the Canaanites and their cities to destruction, so they named the place Meribah.
